note: Prepared decide requests, not applied. Submit each record via nforge agent OWNER decide or forge_task. decidedAt is omitted when the plan gives no date; creation supplies recording time. Reasons paraphrase the plan context. Overrides are only supplied where an existing default is identified; the plan does not name an earlier decision record. Recording these facts does not enable their product behavior.

records.what: Briefly red main is accepted for trusted and autonomous actors, with automatic fix-forward or revert. Supervised projects keep the strict full gate.
records.why: Let contract-gated work land while continuous checks repair regressions; keep supervised behavior strict.

overrides.description: A passing full suite is required before every acceptance.

records.what: Storage is decided by SP1: native on R2 with reachability GC versus Git-native objects and packfiles on the same criteria. Build APFS clonefile Lanes with snapshots early regardless of the winner. A Git-native winner also requires an explicit change to design constraint 7.
records.why: Choose from comparable evidence about disk, GC correctness, interoperability, migration and composition cost.

records.what: Structural merge is either mergiraf or our own merge over tree-sitter declarations, compared in SP2. The contract check gates the output, never parse success.
records.why: Evaluate both approaches before choosing; syntax alone cannot establish behavioral correctness.

overrides.description: Line-based merge is the current merge strategy.

records.what: Web breadth is frozen until E1 and E3 are published and Bet 1 is cut over. Hosted landing gaps G1–G10 are frozen except G1, G2, G3 and G6 needed by Bet 1.
records.why: Focus current work on authority cutover and the published evidence.

records.what: Bet 1 is imperative and starts at Phase 5 start; its prerequisites are the first slices built.
records.why: The dual-master authority model is the central operational cause to remove first.

records.what: Trust per path per actor (B2.6) is a new access rule. The owner approves its defaults before it is enabled.
records.why: The build plan does not itself authorize new access restrictions or defaults.

records.what: Vocabulary consolidation is a real slice set built after the Bet 1 cutover. No functionality is lost.
records.why: Consolidate the surface after authority is settled while preserving capability.

records.what: Bet 3 build waits only for E1 and E3. E2 runs during Bet 1 and must be published before B3.5.
records.why: Build coordination after its baseline and methodology are published; its final measurement also needs E2.

records.what: Every point of the 2026-10-24 review is tracked in Review coverage; none is dropped silently.
records.why: Keep review obligations visible and accounted for in the plan.

records.what: Disk stays bounded per project. Collect automatic snapshots of completed or abandoned Lanes after the 7-day retention window; always keep the latest snapshot of every open Lane. Watch free space and per-project growth and warn before either crosses its budget (P5-M2).
records.why: Retained snapshots and project growth need an explicit owner-approved disk policy.
